inputs: A CompanyConfig, or any nested config/contract mapping to scan
A YAML file written in the supported subset
invariants: no_subagents must be exactly true and the nested-spawn keys exactly false; anything else, including a truthy string, is a violation (rule 2).
Validation collects every issue and raises once, so one run reports the whole problem rather than the first line of it.
The YAML reader is a deliberate subset, not PyYAML: no third-party dependency enters the control plane.
Restricted employment states (candidate, shadow, probation) may not hold production authority (rule 11).
outputs: None on success; ValidationError or YamlSubsetError carrying every issue found
A list of no-subagent violations, each naming the offending config path
purpose: Parses the YAML subset the bootstrap contracts are written in, validates the org, permissions and contract shapes, and enforces the no-subagent rule over any nested config mapping.
risks: Validation must not import runtime implementation modules; shared bootstrap data contracts live in company/config_types.py.
Owned by the Codex workstream: another session may be editing it concurrently.
title: Company validation and no-subagent enforcement
